title: This lava is over 1,100 °C 🔥 Iceland volcano #shorts
description:
The Litli-Hrútur eruption on Iceland's Reykjanes peninsula started on 10 July 2023 – about 30 km from Reykjavík. Thousands of people hiked roughly 20 km (round trip) to see it. Basaltic lava like this is well over 1,100 °C hot.

Filmed with a drone over the crater.

📍 Litli-Hrútur, Reykjanes, Iceland 🇮🇸
📸 Instagram: @p.x.mgmt
